records.title: MSGRL: A Motif-Driven Self-Supervised Graph Representation Learning Framework for Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
records.reason: The abstract proposes molecular graph representation learning for property prediction; it is unrelated to LLM inference or serving.

records.title: NeuroMesh: A Bottleneck Topology Controller for Missing-Modality Brain Tumor Segmentation — A Mechanistic Pilot Study on BraTS
records.reason: The abstract evaluates a U-Net-style MRI missing-modality segmentation controller, not LLM inference.

records.title: Groundhog Bit-Flip Attack: Seeding Infinite Generation Loops in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs through Bit Flips
records.reason: The work is a bit-flip denial-of-wallet attack on MoE LLMs; its contribution is an attack/security result rather than an efficiency method.

records.title: PointRL: Learning Point-Level Vision-Language Grounding from Verifiable Annotation Evidence
records.reason: PointRL trains point-level vision-language grounding from annotations; this is task learning, not inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: LLMscope: Extracting LLM Assets from Edge AI Chips via Optical Probing
records.reason: The paper is a physical side-channel extraction attack against LLM accelerator assets, not an inference optimization.
